query: Detach the Contract content type from the Contracts library. Show me the plan first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-detach-content-type-from-list.ps1 with -PlanPath and without -Execute, as a dry run
States the dry run prints a structured JSON action plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real run

query: The plan looks right. Apply it for real.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute and -ConfirmToken DETACH-SPO-CONTENT-TYPE to the same command
Treats the real run as a live tenant write that the user runs, not something to run unprompted
Does not alter the plan content between the dry run and the real run

query: Will this delete the content type from the site?
expected_behavior: Says detaching unlinks the content type from that list only and leaves the site content type in place
Points to the remove-content-type skill for deleting it from the site collection
Makes no write without -Execute and the token
